about: Three correlations no set of inputs can have at once.

files.model.yaml:
model: tiny
title: Impossible triangle
currency: USD

nodes:

  request_rate:
    kind: input
    decided: outside
    unit: request/second
    value: 200
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "the busy hour, as stated for this case"}

  service_demand:
    kind: input
    decided: outside
    unit: core*second/request
    value: 0.02
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "processor time per request, as stated for this case"}

  cores:
    kind: input
    decided: you
    unit: core
    value: 16
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "the fleet chosen for this case"}

  busy_cores:
    kind: derived
    unit: core
    formula: request_rate * service_demand

  utilisation:
    kind: derived
    unit: dimensionless
    formula: busy_cores / cores

  a_rate:
    kind: input
    decided: outside
    unit: request/second
    distribution: {uniform: {minimum: 100.0, maximum: 300.0}}
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "uniform: the bounds are all that is known"}

  b_rate:
    kind: input
    decided: outside
    unit: request/second
    distribution: {uniform: {minimum: 100.0, maximum: 300.0}}
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "uniform: the bounds are all that is known"}

  c_rate:
    kind: input
    decided: outside
    unit: request/second
    distribution: {uniform: {minimum: 100.0, maximum: 300.0}}
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "uniform: the bounds are all that is known"}

  all_rates:
    kind: derived
    unit: request/second
    formula: a_rate + b_rate + c_rate

outputs:
  - utilisation
  - all_rates

correlations:
  - {a: a_rate, b: b_rate, rho: 0.9, because: "stated for this case"}
  - {a: b_rate, b: c_rate, rho: 0.9, because: "stated for this case"}
  - {a: a_rate, b: c_rate, rho: -0.9, because: "stated for this case"}
